item.description: The Tasmanian government has effectively been leasing out a stadium to property developer and NBL owner Larry Kestelman for less than it would cost to rent most houses in the area, a parliamentary report has found.

item.title: ABC News: Nobel Peace Prize won't go to Trump this year, experts say
item.description: It is often regarded as the most prestigious of all Nobel prizes, which are given to those who have "conferred the greatest benefit to mankind". But the Nobel Peace Prize can also be controversial.

item.title: ABC News: Illegal tobacco crackdown in Victoria has come too late, says ex-policeman
item.description: Premier Ben Carroll has conceded the Victorian government should have acted sooner on illegal tobacco but insisted progress had been made since the new enforcement powers came into effect.

item.title: ABC News: Yemen's government declares major operation against Houthis
item.description: The Houthis have withstood a series of attacks over the years by Saudi Arabia, the UAE and their Western allies, and have updated their weaponry with the help of Iran.

item.title: ABC News: Cowboys and girls dress up for Santa Teresa/Ltyentye Apurte horse races
item.description: In this remote corner of central Australia, the Santa Teresa/Ltyentye Apurte horse races are a dusty affair with the best in cowboy fashion.

item.title: ABC News: NT man caught driving 100km/h over speed limit
item.description: Northern Territory Police have charged a man with speeding and high-range drink driving after catching him allegedly driving at more than 100km/h over the limit before returning a blood-alcohol result of 0.153.

item.title: ABC News: He was the best forward in the grand final, but Whyte's best is yet to come
item.description: Naufahu Whyte wouldn't have looked out of place should he have won the Clive Churchill Medal after the Roosters' grand final victory, and the Tricolours prop is adamant we have yet to see his best.

item.title: ABC News: Bank of America has a warning for Australia's $4.5 trillion superannuation sector
item.description: Interest rates are approaching levels that would hurt Australia's economy and the retirement savings managed by major superannuation funds, according to the Bank of America's head of interest rates strategy.

item.title: ABC News: Yeo makes World Cup call, Walker earns Kangaroos spot
item.description: The grand final sides feature in the Kangaroos squad for the Rugby League World Cup, with James Tedesco back in and Sydney's Sam Walker and Newcastle's Bradman Best among six debutants.

item.title: ABC News: New movie corrects the record on Tenzing Norgay's Everest climb
item.description: Australian filmmaker Jennifer Peedom fell in love with the Himalayas as a young woman. She is now retelling its most famous story.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Bolsonaro defies expectations in Brazil presidential vote to face Lula in run-off
item.description: Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro, son of the far-right former leader Jair Bolsonaro, has finished ahead of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the country's election, which will go to a run-off in three weeks.

item.title: ABC News: Tom Cruise movie Digger bombs at box office, Verity takes top spot
item.description: Movie star Tom Cruise suffers one of the worst debuts of his career with his new movie Digger.

item.title: ABC News: Auction clearance rate sinks to three-month low as property market slows
item.description: Australia's auction clearance rate has slumped to a three-month low, while new data shows the number of unsold homes has surged by more than 20 per cent in the past year.

item.title: ABC News: Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash plane into airport, Israeli media reports
item.description: The flydubai co-pilot allegedly tells investigators he intended to continue flying normally before crashing into the main airport in Israel.
